systems.system: dossier patient électronique de planification familiale (MSupply)
systems.country_label: dossier patient électronique de planification familiale
systems.owner: Ministry of Health with UNFPA; technical expertise from the mSupply Foundation
systems.tiers: 23 public health facilities across the country, deployed 7 to 13 May 2025; tiers not stated; used by midwives and programme managers

note: No fact: the one system described is a patient-level electronic record for a single programme, family planning, so the typology makes it a tracker and not an emr, whatever its name; it replaces manual data management in 23 public facilities from 7 to 13 May 2025. The national health information system is named only as what the tool will be integrated with, with no description of what it does.
